title: The Black Dog
text: A black dog the size of a calf pads beside the party for a mile, saying nothing, its paws making no sound on the stones. Its eyes are wet and red. Then it sits in the road and looks at one of you, only one, the way a dog looks at its master.

options.label: The one it looks at meets its red eyes.

outcomes.text: It wags once, slowly, and goes. It was only looking. This time.
It was not only looking. It knows them now, and it will come again, at the end.

options.label: Feed it, and hope it leaves.

outcomes.text: It eats with a crunch of bone, and goes, and does not come back for anyone.
It goes, without hurry. It will be back, for someone, some day.
